title: Partners
subtitle: For teams that want to send their token to BlockBite players who meet a rule you choose.
sign_in_note: Connect the wallet your team will use and sign a short message to prove you own it. Signing is not a transaction and moves no funds.
not_configured: The partner console is not configured on this server yet.
apply_body: Tell us who you are and which token you want to distribute. The BlockBite team reviews each application by hand.
name: Project name
status_pending: Your application is waiting for review.
status_rejected: Your application was not approved. You can update it and send it again.
status_approved: Approved. You can create campaigns and fund them.
rule_daily_top: Daily top N of the ranked board
deposit_body: Send the campaign token to the distributor wallet below (or straight to its token account), then paste the transaction signature. We check the finalized transaction on-chain (read only) for the mint, the amount and this recipient.
how_body: You send tokens to the BlockBite distributor. Players who meet your rule get an allocation and claim it themselves: they sign and pay the network fee and the token account rent. The total allocated never exceeds what you deposited.
rule_amounts: Amount per rank, best first (comma separated)
deposit_missing: The distributor is not configured on this server yet, so deposits cannot be recognized.
paused: Paused: no new allocations and no claims.
rewards_sign_in: Sign in to see partner rewards
rewards_fee_note: Claiming needs a small SOL network fee, plus the token account rent the first time you receive this token. You pay it; the reward is sent to your wallet.
